notes.title: 0.11.12 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3] Version 0.11.12 Change log[/h3]

Features:
[list]
[*] The game has a tag system now. Items that are more suitable for the current run will appear in the shop more often!
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] The talisman “Rage” now displays changes in the attack stat.
[*] Localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.11.11 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3] Version 0.11.11 Change log[/h3]

Features:
[list]
[*] Character animations were added! [spoiler] We're really exited about this one! [/spoiler]
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where selected settings were not saved after restarting the game.
[*] Ship and Captain stats are no longer saved between runs.
[*] The "Card on Burn" talisman now actually grants a card.
[*] Localization fixes.

[/list]

notes.title: 0.11.08 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3] Version 0.11.08 Change log[/h3]

Features:
[list]
[*] Reroll ability was added. Now Captain can reroll any die once per battle.
[*] Now bomb deals [strike]5[/strike]->3 damage.
[*] Battles now finish immediately when any HP drops below 0.
[*] Base enemy stats are now displayed with talismans.
[*] Dice net was added to hint on hover.
[*] Talisman icons were added to hint on hover.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]  Artifact cooldowns are now interrupted when you leave a battle.
[*] It’s now less clear which answer is correct in the "Mermaid" event.
[*] Bombs added  to die via dice upgrade now go into the correct slot and deal damage after 1->3 turns.
[*] Artifacts can now be used at the start of the battle.
[*] "Price reduction" talisman reduces price for [strike]100[/strike]->25% now, as written in the description.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.11.04 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3] Version 0.11.04 Change log[/h3]

Features:
[list]
[*] New artifact was added. [spoiler]'Rum' uses energy and gives some random effect.[/spoiler]
[*] Repair cards were added as a reward after medium-difficulty battles. Now there’s an opportunity to survive several fights in a row until finally reaching the shop.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Some talisman descriptions on English were fixed.
[*] The 'No Effects Card Repair' talisman now works correctly. Previously, it was not functioning and, moreover, it broke the functionality of an artifacts.
[*] Some text in the 'Serpent' encounter was updated. Losing HP in a tough battle isn’t really luck, right?
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is Available!
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers!

We've been looking forward to this moment for a long time, and we're excited to announce that the demo is now available on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741011/dafc308c4fe5e28f61b053f33623d21a795a168e.png[/img]
Game is available for both Windows and MacOS. 

We want to share the joy of this significant and important event for our small team with you! 
Play, add Dice Captain to your wishlists, and may the sea winds be favorable to you!

notes.title: Version 0.09.02
notes.content:
Version 0.09.02 is now available!
[h3]What's New:[/h3]
• Save system and the ability to clear saves were added.
• Global currency and its accumulation were added.
• A window with statistics and general information now appears at the end of the run.
• Added a pause menu and a quit game button!
• Mini-boss and boss characters have been drawn and added to the project.
• The Captain got a face! [I]Handsome, isn't he?[/i]
• Combat now ends immediately when one of the opponents' health drops to zero.
• Full hint was hidden, now it's available when pressing alt and can be enabled in settings.
• The "surrender" button is available on the map and in combat. No need to finish the run if Lady Luck turns away from you.
• The shop window has been updated, and the merchant's assortment has been expanded. [i]Watch out for discounts![/i]
• Added a button to view your build in map, shop, and end of run windows.
• Tutorial has been added! [I]Have ye met our feathered mate yet?[/i]
• Dice roll results are now visually grouped in the combat window: it's clearer what effects will affect an enemy and what will remain with you.
• Settings window update.
• Updated dice rolling sound.
• The map window camera no longer jumps back to the bottom of the map. [i]It's more comfortable, isn't it?[/i]

Many new text events and additional changes have been added:
• Events now check if you have enough gold before offering you options to spend it;
• Damage is dealt in events [i](no more sneaking through unnoticed)[/i];
• Unique event development branches and story-chains have been added;
• Percentages of outcomes and even color-coded results are displayed in events now. [strike]No intrigue[/strike]

Additionally, numerous minor fixes, tweaks, visual updates, and overall gameplay improvements have been made. Phew! It's been a long three months, but now we're on the home stretch to the public demo version! And may the sea be calm (and fewer bugs)!

notes.title: Dice Captain is here!
notes.content:
Ahoy, our hearties and fellow adventurers!

We are a small team of roguelike lovers who decided to make our dream indie game a reality. We drew inspiration from well-known projects and aim to add our own twist to the tale.

After six months of navigating rough waters, trials and errors, testing mechanics, and refining our ideas, we have finally reached the stage where the Demo release is just around the corner. 
As it is known, this is the perfect moment to share more about our journey and updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741011/7167a8f55817b128bd47bd2f26c595fda18907a2.png[/img]
In a nutshell, in our game, you will be able to take the role of a ship captain, conquer over randomness, and meet interesting characters. 

Toss our project to your wishlist to motivate us to work even harder!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465690/Dice_Captain/


May the winds blow in your favor matey!
